subject: Post-call recap: Renewal pricing — clarify volume bands & blended rates
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Charlie Taylor <ctaylor@healthsys.org>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Renewal pricing — clarify volume bands & blended rates

Charlie — thanks for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our call and the asks so we have a shared action plan.

Call summary (high level):
- HealthSys current monthly usage: ~6M tokens (mostly standard generation routes).
- Expected step-up: phased increase to ~30M tokens/month by Q3 (30M = 20M standard routes + 10M higher-cap routes for summaries/long-context).
- HealthSys procurement target: an aggregated/blended cost target of ~$65–75 per 1M tokens (company-wide blended target).
- Primary asks from you: example blended calculation, confirmation of volume bands and discounts, and a sample renewal term that supports step-ups without immediate re-negotiation.

What we (Redwood) proposed on the call:
- Renewal structure with tiered unit pricing by monthly band and a blended example based on your projected mix.
- Option: commit to a 12-month renewal with quarterly reconciliation and step-up triggers at 10M and 25M.
- Add-on: ability to route higher-cost models to a separate route with explicit per-route pricing so blended math is transparent.

Action items / next steps:
1) I will send a concrete blended-pricing example and a revised proposal (attached). (Action: Neha)
2) Charlie / Jared to confirm anticipated model mix (percent of high-cap routes vs standard). (Action: HealthSys)
3) If the blended target looks good, we can draft a renewal SOW + PO and include quarterly usage reconciliation. (Action: Finance / Procurement)

Attachments I just uploaded: HealthSys_Renewal_Proposal_v2.pdf, blended-pricing-example.xlsx, mutual-action-plan.docx

If helpful, I can sketch two scenarios (conservative and aggressive) with line-item blended math — want that or prefer we keep it to one proposal?

Thanks — speaking with Karthik and Marissa to finalize the blended examples now.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

--
Redwood Inference | developer-first inference platform

From: Charlie Taylor <ctaylor@healthsys.org>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jared Lin <jlin@healthsys.org>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Renewal pricing — clarify volume bands & blended rates

Thanks Neha — that recap is accurate. A couple quick clarifications from our side before you run numbers: 

1) Model mix: today ~85% standard gen, ~15% higher-cap (summaries/long-context). If we hit Q3 volume, that may shift to roughly 65% standard / 35% higher-cap.
2) Our procurement team wants an apples-to-apples blended $/1M tokens example that includes any route-level add-ons (e.g., streaming or long-context premium). Please show the blended number and the per-band rates.
3) Budget range: rough preferred renewal spend range is $2k–$3k/month initially, but we would like the headroom to grow to $6k–$8k/month by Q3 if the model performance warrants it.

Two quick questions: will the blended calculation change materially if we route 10% of traffic to a cached prefix route (lower per-token cost)? And are there any minimum-commit clauses we should expect?

If you can push the blended example today, we can review and loop in procurement.

Charlie Taylor
Director, AI Platforms | HealthSys
ctaylor@healthsys.org

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Charlie Taylor <ctaylor@healthsys.org>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Renewal pricing — clarify volume bands & blended rates

Charlie — thanks, good clarifications. Below are two concise blended examples (attached spreadsheet has the line-by-line math). I included a cached-prefix scenario as requested.

Scenario A — conservative (projected 20M / month):
- Band pricing (list):
  - 0–10M: $95 / 1M tokens (standard routes)
  - 10–50M: $62 / 1M tokens (standard routes discounted)
  - High-cap route (long-context/summaries): $160 / 1M tokens (no stacking discount for specialized routes)
  - Cached-prefix route: $28 / 1M tokens (applies only to cached traffic)

- Example math (20M total; assumed mix = 65% standard (13M), 25% high-cap (5M), 10% cached (2M)):
  - Standard (13M): 10M at $95 + 3M at $62 = (10*$95 + 3*$62) = $950 + $186 = $1,136
  - High-cap (5M): 5*$160 = $800
  - Cached (2M): 2*$28 = $56
  - Total spend = $1,136 + $800 + $56 = $1,992
  - Blended $/1M = $1,992 / 20 = $99.6 (~$100 / 1M)

Scenario B — aggressive step-up (30M / month target):
- Same band prices; assumed mix = 67% standard (20M), 33% high-cap or cached (10M where cached is 3M):
  - Standard (20M): 10M at $95 + 10M at $62 = $950 + $620 = $1,570
  - High-cap (7M): 7*$160 = $1,120
  - Cached (3M): 3*$28 = $84
  - Total spend = $1,570 + $1,120 + $84 = $2,774
  - Blended $/1M = $2,774 / 30 = $92.47 (~$92 / 1M)

Notes:
- Blended number moves down as volume shifts into the 10–50M band and as a greater share uses cached prefixes.
- If HealthSys commits to a 12-month renewal with quarterly reconciliation, we can push the 10–50M band rate to $58 / 1M for standard routes (would lower blended by ~3–6% depending on mix).
- No hard minimums on usage; we recommend a committed spend floor for credit purposes only (we can propose $15k quarterly) but can keep flexibility for step-ups.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm the model mix assumption (today vs Q3 target).
- If the improved discount ($58 / 1M) is appealing, we can draft a renewal term sheet showing the 12-month commit + quarterly reconciliation + right to step-up without re-pricing inside bands.

Karthik / Marissa — anything to add on the commercial mechanics or potential one-time credit to stay within HealthSys’s stated initial budget band ($2k–$3k)?

Best,
Neha

(Attachment: blended-pricing-example.xlsx — tab summary has line-by-line math)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Charlie Taylor <ctaylor@healthsys.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 06 May 2026 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Renewal pricing — clarify volume bands & blended rates

Thanks Neha — helpful breakdown. Two quick commercial notes from Finance: 

1) If HealthSys signs a 12-month renewal with the step-up language and quarterly reconciliation, we can offer an introductory one-time renewal credit of $3,000 applied in month 1 to help bridge initial budget constraints (this would keep first month spend within your $2k–$3k ask).
2) We prefer a usage reconciliation clause (quarterly) rather than minimums. That protects both sides as volume grows; we will include a tiered credit schedule if actual usage exceeds projections by >20% in a quarter.

Suggested next step: Neha / HealthSys confirm the Q3 target mix (percent standard/high-cap/cached) and I will draft a short term sheet including the $58 / 1M option, the $3k one-time credit, and the reconciliation language. If that looks good, we can move to PO + SOW + DocuSign.

Karthik
VP, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
